notes: Source: official Biamp data sheet (TESFDS-355-2010-EN-R1), including rear-panel photo/diagram. 12 mic/line analog inputs and 8 mic/line analog outputs are on balanced, screw-down/removable (euroblock-style) terminal blocks, individually numbered 1-12 (inputs) and 1-8 (outputs) on the rear panel; phantom power +48VDC available per input. Two RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet ports: one labeled "Dante" (32x32 channel Dante/AES67 digital audio) and one labeled "Control" (Tesira system configuration/control) - both graded eth-1g per the "2 Gigabit Ethernet ports" spec. RS-232 port is shown on the rear panel as a terminal-block style connector (screw terminals) rather than a DB9 in the photo, but the A&E spec just calls it "RS-232 connection" - modeled as rs232 connector (closest standard id) with a note. USB port is standard USB-B (device-side USB Class 1 Audio, up to 8 ch/48kHz/16-24bit), bidirectional. Logic I/O block is a 4-channel software-configurable GPIO on screw terminals plus a +5V pin - modeled as a single euroblock control port since "ir"/"rs485" etc. do not fit generic logic I/O; noted as GPIO. Power inlet is a standard IEC C14 (IEC) inlet per rear panel image, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz universal supply, no on/off switch shown. No HDMI/video/SDI I/O exists on this device (it is audio-DSP only). Rack unit: 1RU per data sheet.
